case_name: Add a logo or text overlay
title: Fox Logo Throughout the Clip
tests: Tests persistent corner-logo compositing, clean background removal, and preservation of the source video and audio.

judge.summary: The output shows a clean, small fox logo with comfortable top-right padding and no visible unwanted changes to the kitchen footage.

must_haves.item: The video shows the same woman at the kitchen table, with the source framing and sequence preserved.
must_haves.why: The woman, kitchen, and framing match the source, and the sampled frames show natural changes in expression and hand position.

must_haves.item: The supplied orange-hoodie fox appears in the top-right corner from the first frame through the last frame.
must_haves.why: The supplied fox is consistently positioned in all four output samples, but the first and last frames are not provided.

must_haves.item: The fox has no visible white rectangular background and is not clipped at the frame edges.
must_haves.why: The kitchen is visible around the fox silhouette, with no white rectangle and clear space from the top and right edges.

must_haves.item: The logo remains small and does not obscure the woman's face.
must_haves.why: The logo occupies a small corner area and stays well clear of the woman's face in every sample.

must_haves.item: The original speech remains audible and synchronized throughout the 10-second clip.
must_haves.why: The supplied audio report confirms audible speech over the approximately 10-second output, but synchronization and exact preservation of the source audio cannot be verified from stills and a transcript.
